name: RedSage-OpenQA-Benchmark
description: An open-domain question answering benchmark dataset hosted on Hugging Face that collects QA instances for evaluating generative and extractive OpenQA systems. Designed to measure answer correctness and coverage across diverse question types, it supports evaluation with both exact-match and token-level metrics. Useful for assessing model retrieval+generation pipelines and end-to-end QA performance.
reputation: A recent community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for open-domain QA benchmarking.
